title: VAV-3 Zone Temperature Sensor Frozen
description: VAV-3's zone temperature sensor stops updating and reports a fixed value regardless of what the actual (simulated) zone conditions are doing, causing the zone control loop to chase a stale reading.

events.description: AHU-1 fan on to establish airflow
Zone Temp freezes at whatever value it happens to be reading at t+60s and never updates again

expected_results: VAV-3 Zone Temp stops changing entirely, even as damper position, airflow, and discharge temp continue responding normally to commands
WebCTRL's zone control loop for VAV-3 will chase the frozen reading, likely driving the damper toward one extreme since it never sees the zone reach setpoint
VAV-1, VAV-2, and the other virtual zones are unaffected
completion_criteria: Student identifies the frozen reading by noting Zone Temp shows zero variation over a trend period where it should be moving
Student distinguishes this from a valve/damper fault by checking that airflow and discharge temp ARE still responding
instructor_notes: A good pairing exercise with vav1_reheat_valve_stuck -- same class of symptom (control loop chasing a stale signal) with two different root causes (sensor vs actuator), useful for teaching how to tell them apart.
student_objectives: Recognize a frozen/stuck sensor from trend behavior alone
Correctly rule out actuator failure when downstream points (airflow, discharge temp) are still responding normally
